ORION POST-RUN ANALYSIS
i2-style workbook: pick a Run, select a Lap, then read the left lap sheet against linked traces, GPS map, GG plot, platform, and slip.

panels.title: Lap Sheet - Click Lap To Select

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_partitions AS (
  SELECT p.start_time, p.end_time
  FROM partitions p
  WHERE ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[] @> ARRAY['$__all']::text[]
     OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])
), run_bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MIN(start_time), $__from::bigint), $__from::bigint) AS run_start,
         LEAST(COALESCE(MAX(end_time), $__to::bigint), $__to::bigint) AS run_end
  FROM selected_partitions
), selected_lap AS (
  SELECT NULLIF('${Lap:raw}', '$__all') AS lap_value
), bounds AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN selected_lap.lap_value IS NULL OR selected_lap.lap_value !~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+$'
      THEN run_bounds.run_start ELSE split_part(selected_lap.lap_value, ':', 1)::bigint END AS effective_start,
    CASE WHEN selected_lap.lap_value IS NULL OR selected_lap.lap_value !~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+$'
      THEN run_bounds.run_end ELSE split_part(selected_lap.lap_value, ':', 2)::bigint END AS effective_end
  FROM run_bounds CROSS JOIN selected_lap
), granularity AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms
)
, run_laps AS (
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY start_time) AS lap,
         start_time,
         LEAD(start_time) OVER (ORDER BY start_time) AS next_time,
         notes
  FROM classifier, run_bounds
  WHERE type = 'lap' AND start_time BETWEEN run_bounds.run_start AND run_bounds.run_end
), lap_metrics AS (
  SELECT run_laps.lap, run_laps.start_time, run_laps.next_time, (run_laps.next_time - run_laps.start_time) / 1000.0 AS lap_s,
         MAX(d.gps_speed * 2.23694) AS max_mph,
         AVG(c.apps1_travel) AS avg_throttle,
         MAX(c.brake_pressure_f) AS peak_brake_f
  FROM run_laps
  LEFT JOIN packet p ON p.time >= run_laps.start_time AND p.time < COALESCE(run_laps.next_time, run_laps.start_time + 120000)
  LEFT JOIN dynamics d ON d.packet_id = p.packet_id
  LEFT JOIN controls c ON c.packet_id = p.packet_id
  WHERE run_laps.next_time IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY run_laps.lap, run_laps.start_time, run_laps.next_time
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, MIN(lap_s) OVER () AS best_lap_s
  FROM lap_metrics
)
SELECT lap AS "lap",
       to_char(to_timestamp(start_time / 1000.0), 'HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS "start",
       ROUND(lap_s::numeric, 3) AS "lap time [s]",
       ROUND((lap_s - best_lap_s)::numeric, 3) AS "delta [s]",
       ROUND(max_mph::numeric, 1) AS "max [mph]",
       ROUND(avg_throttle::numeric, 1) AS "avg throttle [%]",
       ROUND(peak_brake_f::numeric, 1) AS "peak brake F [psi]",
       CONCAT(start_time, ':', next_time) AS lap_value,
       start_time AS start_ms,
       next_time AS end_ms
FROM ranked
ORDER BY lap;

SELECT to_timestamp(p.time / 1000.0) AS time,
       d.gps[1] AS lat,
       d.gps[2] AS lon,
       d.gps_speed * 2.23694 AS speed_mph,
       c.apps1_travel AS throttle,
       c.brake_pressure_f AS brake_f,
       p.packet_id AS id
FROM dynamics d
JOIN packet p ON p.packet_id = d.packet_id
LEFT JOIN controls c ON c.packet_id = d.packet_id
JOIN bounds ON true
WHERE p.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end
  AND d.gps IS NOT NULL AND array_length(d.gps, 1) >= 2
  AND d.gps[1] BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND d.gps[2] BETWEEN -180 AND 180

ORDER BY p.time;

panels.title: GG Diagram
panels.description: Lat/long acceleration envelope from GPS IMU.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_partitions AS (
  SELECT p.start_time, p.end_time
  FROM partitions p
  WHERE ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[] @> ARRAY['$__all']::text[]
     OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])
), run_bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MIN(start_time), $__from::bigint), $__from::bigint) AS run_start,
         LEAST(COALESCE(MAX(end_time), $__to::bigint), $__to::bigint) AS run_end
  FROM selected_partitions
), selected_lap AS (
  SELECT NULLIF('${Lap:raw}', '$__all') AS lap_value
), bounds AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN selected_lap.lap_value IS NULL OR selected_lap.lap_value !~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+$'
      THEN run_bounds.run_start ELSE split_part(selected_lap.lap_value, ':', 1)::bigint END AS effective_start,
    CASE WHEN selected_lap.lap_value IS NULL OR selected_lap.lap_value !~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+$'
      THEN run_bounds.run_end ELSE split_part(selected_lap.lap_value, ':', 2)::bigint END AS effective_end
  FROM run_bounds CROSS JOIN selected_lap
), granularity AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms
)
SELECT AVG(d.gps_imu[1]::double precision) OVER (ORDER BY p.time ROWS BETWEEN 8 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / 9.80665 AS lat_g,
       AVG(-d.gps_imu[2]::double precision) OVER (ORDER BY p.time ROWS BETWEEN 8 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / 9.80665 AS long_g,
       d.gps_speed * 2.23694 AS speed_mph
FROM dynamics d JOIN packet p ON p.packet_id = d.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true
WHERE p.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end
  AND d.gps_imu IS NOT NULL AND array_length(d.gps_imu, 1) >= 2
  AND p.packet_id % GREATEST(${Stride}::int, 1) = 0
ORDER BY p.time;

      THEN run_bounds.run_end ELSE split_part(selected_lap.lap_value, ':', 2)::bigint END AS effective_end
  FROM run_bounds CROSS JOIN selected_lap
), granularity AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms
)
, samples AS (
  SELECT p.time, d.gps_speed * 2.23694 AS speed_mph, d.steer_col_angle, c.apps1_travel,
         c.brake_pressure_f, c.torque_request, pk.hv_pack_v, pk.hv_c,
         th.motor_temp, th.inverter_temp
  FROM packet p
  LEFT JOIN dynamics d ON d.packet_id = p.packet_id
  LEFT JOIN controls c ON c.packet_id = p.packet_id
  LEFT JOIN pack pk ON pk.packet_id = p.packet_id
  LEFT JOIN thermal th ON th.packet_id = p.packet_id
  JOIN bounds ON true
  WHERE p.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end
), energy_samples AS (
  SELECT time, hv_pack_v, hv_c, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time
  FROM samples
  WHERE hv_pack_v IS NOT NULL AND hv_c IS NOT NULL
), energy AS (
  SELECT SUM(((COALESCE(next_time, time) - time) / 1000.0) * hv_pack_v * hv_c) / 3600000.0 AS kwh
  FROM energy_samples
)
SELECT 'start' AS metric, to_char(to_timestamp(MIN(time) / 1000.0), 'HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS value FROM samples
UNION ALL SELECT 'duration', ROUND(((MAX(time) - MIN(time)) / 1000.0)::numeric, 3)::text FROM samples
UNION ALL SELECT 'max speed mph', ROUND(MAX(speed_mph)::numeric, 1)::text FROM samples
UNION ALL SELECT 'avg throttle pct', ROUND(AVG(apps1_travel)::numeric, 1)::text FROM samples
UNION ALL SELECT 'peak brake psi', ROUND(MAX(brake_pressure_f)::numeric, 1)::text FROM samples
UNION ALL SELECT 'steer min/max deg', CONCAT(ROUND(MIN(steer_col_angle)::numeric, 1), ' / ', ROUND(MAX(steer_col_angle)::numeric, 1)) FROM samples
UNION ALL SELECT 'net energy kWh', ROUND((SELECT kwh FROM energy)::numeric, 3)::text
UNION ALL SELECT 'max motor C', ROUND(MAX(motor_temp)::numeric, 1)::text FROM samples
UNION ALL SELECT 'max inverter C', ROUND(MAX(inverter_temp)::numeric, 1)::text FROM samples;

WITH selected_partitions AS (
  SELECT p.start_time, p.end_time
  FROM partitions p
  WHERE ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[] @> ARRAY['$__all']::text[]
     OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])
), run_bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MIN(start_time), $__from::bigint), $__from::bigint) AS run_start,
         LEAST(COALESCE(MAX(end_time), $__to::bigint), $__to::bigint) AS run_end
  FROM selected_partitions
), selected_lap AS (
  SELECT NULLIF('${Lap:raw}', '$__all') AS lap_value
), bounds AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN selected_lap.lap_value IS NULL OR selected_lap.lap_value !~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+$'
      THEN run_bounds.run_start ELSE split_part(selected_lap.lap_value, ':', 1)::bigint END AS effective_start,
    CASE WHEN selected_lap.lap_value IS NULL OR selected_lap.lap_value !~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+$'
      THEN run_bounds.run_end ELSE split_part(selected_lap.lap_value, ':', 2)::bigint END AS effective_end
  FROM run_bounds CROSS JOIN selected_lap
), granularity AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms
)
SELECT to_timestamp(floor(p.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time,
       AVG((d.fl_ride_height + d.fr_ride_height) / 2.0) AS "front platform [mm]",
       AVG((d.bl_ride_height + d.br_ride_height) / 2.0) AS "rear platform [mm]",
       AVG((d.fl_ride_height + d.bl_ride_height) / 2.0) AS "left platform [mm]",
       AVG((d.fr_ride_height + d.br_ride_height) / 2.0) AS "right platform [mm]",
       AVG(((d.fl_ride_height + d.fr_ride_height) - (d.bl_ride_height + d.br_ride_height)) / 2.0) AS "rake proxy [mm]",
       AVG(((d.fr_ride_height + d.br_ride_height) - (d.fl_ride_height + d.bl_ride_height)) / 2.0) AS "roll proxy [mm]"
FROM dynamics d JOIN packet p ON p.packet_id = d.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true
WHERE p.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH selected_partitions AS (
  SELECT p.start_time, p.end_time
  FROM partitions p
  WHERE ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[] @> ARRAY['$__all']::text[]
     OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])
), run_bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MIN(start_time), $__from::bigint), $__from::bigint) AS run_start,
         LEAST(COALESCE(MAX(end_time), $__to::bigint), $__to::bigint) AS run_end
  FROM selected_partitions
), selected_lap AS (
  SELECT NULLIF('${Lap:raw}', '$__all') AS lap_value
), bounds AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN selected_lap.lap_value IS NULL OR selected_lap.lap_value !~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+$'
      THEN run_bounds.run_start ELSE split_part(selected_lap.lap_value, ':', 1)::bigint END AS effective_start,
    CASE WHEN selected_lap.lap_value IS NULL OR selected_lap.lap_value !~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+$'
      THEN run_bounds.run_end ELSE split_part(selected_lap.lap_value, ':', 2)::bigint END AS effective_end
  FROM run_bounds CROSS JOIN selected_lap
), granularity AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms
)
SELECT to_timestamp(floor(p.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time,
       AVG((d.flw_speed + d.frw_speed) / 2.0) AS "front wheel avg [rad/s]",
       AVG((d.blw_speed + d.brw_speed) / 2.0) AS "rear wheel avg [rad/s]",
       AVG(100.0 * (((d.blw_speed + d.brw_speed) / 2.0) - ((d.flw_speed + d.frw_speed) / 2.0)) / NULLIF(((d.flw_speed + d.frw_speed) / 2.0), 0)) AS "rear slip [%]",
       AVG(d.frw_speed - d.flw_speed) AS "front delta [rad/s]",
       AVG(d.brw_speed - d.blw_speed) AS "rear delta [rad/s]"
FROM dynamics d JOIN packet p ON p.packet_id = d.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true
WHERE p.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;
